status: frozen before computation of new effects or intervals
named_findings: Leading pooled probability-of-superiority lacks an uncertainty interval for nine EMC specimens.
Source Malignant classification excludes clinically relevant GIST/DFSP/SFT; quantify one broader source-class sensitivity.
preserved_primary: 9 EMC versus393 source Malignant references/28labels, exact test and 11-gene adjustment unchanged
secondary_selection: All eligible source Malignant OR Intermediate specimens, excluding EMC, melanoma and Spindle cell tumor NOS, retaining all existing recurrence/metastasis/previous-publication exclusions
estimates: specimen-weighted A for primary and inclusive reference
equal-category-weighted A for inclusive reference; primary accepted estimate retained

interval.method: Nominal95% two-sample specimen bootstrap, percentile interval using numpy.quantile(method=linear), resampling EMC and references independently with replacement at original sample sizes
interval.generator: numpy.random.default_rng PCG64; separate fresh same-seed generators for the two references; multinomial specimen weights applied to comparison matrix
qualifications: approximate pointwise intervals conditional on observed specimen/reference design
No correction for retrospective target/reference selection, unknown patient overlap, unmeasured confounding, or incomplete population sampling
All pair dependencies retained by specimen resampling; pairs are never resampled independently
No interpretation of difference between overlapping-reference estimates as a tested effect

no_new_tests: No added P values, thresholds, cohort search, year-effect claims or significance-based comparator selection
display: Figure1 shows all38Malignant/Intermediate labels includingEMC, with primary and added categories identified; Figure2 displays four previously accepted same-histology EMC contrasts across assays. External LMS heatmap moves to FigureS2.
